name: PETROSELINUM SATIVUM
key_symptoms: Thirsty and hungry, but desire fails on beginning to eat or drink.
guiding_symptoms: Thirsty and hungry, but desire fails on beginning to eat or drink.
gi_symptoms: Thirsty and hungry, but desire fails on beginning to eat or drink.
urinary_symptoms: Burning, tingling, from perineum throughout whole urethra; sudden urging, to urinate; frequent, voluptuous tickling in fossa navicularis. Gonorrhśa; sudden, irresistible desire to urinate; intense biting, itching, deep in urethra; milky discharge.
